subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer the single enabled/configured account after explicit/default/bound precedence, or should OpenClaw keep requiring explicit `accountId` or `defaultAccount` when the configured default is disabled?
rationale: The requested fallback changes documented default-account behavior for existing multi-account setups, so maintainer product intent is needed before the linked PR can land.

options.title: Accept Shared Resolver Policy
options.body: Land or replace a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound account IDs first, then selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account, with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

options.title: Keep Explicit Account Selection
options.body: Keep current default-account semantics and document that users must set `accountId` or `defaultAccount` when the default account is disabled.

options.title: Require Channel-Owned Fallback
options.body: Ask for channel-owned fallback behavior if maintainers do not want core to own this policy across message channels.

recommendation.title: Accept Shared Resolver Policy
recommendation.body: Land or replace a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound account IDs first, then selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account, with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the prior resolver direction for this issue and has relevant shared account-helper history.
